body_lead: VIJAYAWADA: The High Court on Tuesday sought a detailed response from the State Government on a petition challenging the allotment of 854.97 acres of agricultural land to Reliance Industries for its proposed giga-scale AI Data Centre and Cable Landing Station project in Vizianagaram district. The matter was posted for further hearing on Thursday. A group of 43 farmers from Bhogapuram mandal of Vizianagaram district sought quashing of G.O. Ms. No.
